rationale: This is a motor-vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder, clearly falling under auto coverage.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 am yesterday; the vehicle is totaled with severe trunk and interior damage. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The at-fault driver's information is documented on the police report. This is a high-severity collision claim requiring immediate adjuster assignment for vehicle valuation and injury documentation.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: Tree fell on policyholder's own parked vehicle causing hood and windshield damage, which is comprehensively covered auto damage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim's parked vehicle (POL-1005) was struck by falling maple tree from their own yard during last night's windstorm, damaging the hood and windshield. Medium-severity comprehensive auto claim with $1,000 deductible; vehicle inspection needed to assess full scope of damage.

case_facts.description: own maple tree fell in wind, damaged hood and windshield of parked car
